items.title: Johnson & Johnson (JNJ) Gets FDA Nod For OTTAVA As It Enters Surgical Robotics
items.summary: Johnson & Johnson (NYSE:JNJ) received FDA authorization for its OTTAVA robotic surgical system. The company is moving ahead with the commercial launch of OTTAVA as its first table integrated, soft tissue robotic platform. This marks Johnson & Johnson's entry into the competitive surgical robotics market with a differentiated system design.
